description: This header file defines the 'LinearPlaybackControl' class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for controlling linear playback features in a media application. It includes method declarations for setting/getting channel, seek position, trickplay, tracing, and status, as well as internal methods for demuxer interaction and notification handling.

classes.name: LinearPlaybackControl
classes.description: A plugin class implementing linear playback control features with JSON RPC support.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service object.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, performing necessary cleanup.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: endpoint_set_channel
methods.description: Sets the playback channel for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback channel of a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_set_seek
methods.description: Sets the playback position (seek) for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_seek
methods.description: Gets the current playback position for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_set_trickplay
methods.description: Configures trickplay parameters for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_trickplay
methods.description: Retrieves trickplay status for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_status
methods.description: Checks the playback status of a specified demuxer.
